name: Gospel of Eve
source:
An exorcist that doesn't believe in ghost. A drop-out that's lost about his path in life. The duo's adventure continues in this sequel to Silver Thread as they investigate an allegedly haunted church.

[from [url=https://puchidesign.itch.io/gospel-of-eve]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
不相信鬼魂的驱魔师，与对人生道路感到迷茫的辍学生——这对搭档的冒险将在《Silver Thread》的续作中继续展开，他们将调查一座据称闹鬼的教堂。

[来源：[url=https://puchidesign.itch.io/gospel-of-eve]Itch.io[/url]]
